body: **Every new roof from us comes with a free class 4 upgrade to impact-resistant shingles.** Downspouts and gutter guards are included too.

Your customers already make your case. "Super Nice guy, very prompt and professional." "Thank you for your service, amazing job." They describe a roofer who inspects, files the claim, meets the adjuster and puts a new roof on in a day.
Your site says "Roofing Redefined for Modern Living" with no town, and none of those reviews. Its Services menu goes nowhere.
So we built this site around your customers' words.
strategy.cardsHeading: Be the Roofing Company People Find on Google
strategy.cardsIntro: Each card is one page: what your site does today and what we changed.

cards.title: Homepage
cards.why: The page Google reads to learn who you are and where you work.
problems: The top of the page says "Roofing Redefined for Modern Living", so Google can't tell you're a roofing company in Wichita.
Your menu's "Services" item goes nowhere, so a visitor can't find your work.
The gallery's "Load More" button goes nowhere either.
fixes: A headline that says roofing company in Wichita, KS, right at the top.
Free inspection, claim help and the free class 4 upgrade up front, with your roof, siding, gutter and painting services listed in full.
cards.alsoAdd: Hourly speed monitoring that keeps your site fast for visitors on phones, and speed is something Google uses to rank you.

cards.title: Roof Replacement
cards.why: New roofs are most of your reviews, and they share one page called "Roofing".
problems: Replacement, repair and inspection sit on one page headed only "Roofing", so Google has no page to rank for roof replacement in Wichita.
Not one of your customer reviews appears beside the work.
fixes: Its own page for roof replacement in Wichita, KS: the claim, the free upgrade and roof day.
Reviews on insurance help, one-day roofs and cleanup, each beside its point.
cards.alsoAdd: Call and form tracking that shows which pages and towns your leads come from.

cards.title: Roof Repair
cards.why: A leaking roof is a call you answer fast, and repair has no page of its own.
problems: Repair is one line on the "Roofing" page, so someone searching roof repair in Wichita finds nothing built for them.
fixes: A page for roof repair in Wichita, KS: leaks, storm damage and the free inspection.
The same-day tarp review right beside it.
cards.alsoAdd: Pages planned from what Google actually shows for each search, so every page targets something people really look for.

cards.title: Contact
cards.why: Where a ready customer reaches you.
problems: "Start A Project" on the contact page goes nowhere.
The ZIP code field says "Enter Subject".
fixes: One tap to call at the top of the page, your hours, address and email.
A short list of what to have ready.
cards.alsoAdd: A check of what your competitors offer, so services you didn't think to mention still get their own pages.
